c2_limitations.L2: Temporal signature analysis (obstruction vs posture vs cough vs drift)
c2_limitations.L4: Implantable MEMS sensor in CSF environment

CardioMEMS_US9023529B2.claims: Endovascular pressure sensor for heart failure monitoring
CardioMEMS_US9023529B2.L1_disclosed: PARTIAL — continuous endovascular pressure monitoring, but for heart not CSF
CardioMEMS_US9023529B2.L2_disclosed: NO — no temporal signature analysis for obstruction
CardioMEMS_US9023529B2.L3_disclosed: NO — cardiac anatomy, not eShunt CSF anatomy
CardioMEMS_US9023529B2.L4_disclosed: PARTIAL — implantable MEMS sensor, but in blood not CSF
CardioMEMS_US9023529B2.L5_disclosed: NO — absolute pressure, not differential CSF-venous
CardioMEMS_US9023529B2.L6_disclosed: NO — heart failure monitoring, not obstruction detection
CardioMEMS_US9023529B2.L7_disclosed: PARTIAL — chronic implantation, but in blood not CSF
CardioMEMS_US9023529B2.anticipation_assessment: Does NOT anticipate C2. Missing L2, L3, L5, L6 entirely. L1/L4/L7 are partial (different body system).
CardioMEMS_US9023529B2.obviousness_assessment: WEAK motivation to combine. POSITA working on cardiac pressure monitoring has no obvious motivation to apply to CSF shunt obstruction. Different clinical specialty, different anatomy, different failure mode.

ShuntCheck_US10957902B2.claims: Skin-surface thermal flow detection for shunt obstruction
ShuntCheck_US10957902B2.L2_disclosed: PARTIAL — detects obstruction, but via thermal not pressure
ShuntCheck_US10957902B2.L3_disclosed: PARTIAL — shunt context, but not eShunt-specific
ShuntCheck_US10957902B2.L4_disclosed: NO — external device, not implantable MEMS
ShuntCheck_US10957902B2.L5_disclosed: NO — thermal flow, not differential pressure
ShuntCheck_US10957902B2.L6_disclosed: PARTIAL — obstruction detection, but different mechanism
ShuntCheck_US10957902B2.L7_disclosed: NO — external, no CSF biocompatibility needed
ShuntCheck_US10957902B2.anticipation_assessment: Does NOT anticipate C2. Missing L1, L4, L5, L7. Different sensing modality (thermal vs pressure).
ShuntCheck_US10957902B2.obviousness_assessment: MODERATE motivation to combine. POSITA working on shunt obstruction detection might consider pressure sensing as alternative to thermal. But endovascular implantation is a significant departure from skin-surface approach.

CereVasc_eShunt_US20240299714A1.L1_disclosed: NO — method of positioning, not pressure monitoring
CereVasc_eShunt_US20240299714A1.L3_disclosed: PARTIAL — eShunt anatomy, but not sensing
CereVasc_eShunt_US20240299714A1.anticipation_assessment: Does NOT anticipate C2. Teaches eShunt anatomy (L3 partial) but no sensing mechanism.
CereVasc_eShunt_US20240299714A1.obviousness_assessment: Provides the anatomical context for C2 but does not teach the sensing mechanism. No motivation to combine with CardioMEMS (different body system).

final_assessment.anticipated: NO — no single reference discloses all 7 limitations
final_assessment.obvious: WEAK — strongest motivation is ShuntCheck (moderate), but endovascular implantation is a significant departure. No reference teaches endovascular CSF pressure monitoring.
final_assessment.survives: PROBABLE — C2's novel contribution (continuous endovascular differential pressure with temporal signature analysis) is not anticipated or obviously combined from searched references.
final_assessment.caveat: SEARCH_INCOMPLETE — PatSnap BALANCE_EXHAUSTED. Claim-level search of PatSnap, EPO Espacenet, and USPTO full-text required for definitive §102/§103 assessment.

value_chain.specific_unmet_need: Chronic controlled CNS drug delivery without pump revision surgery or repeated invasive procedures

current_alternatives.name: Ommaya reservoir
current_alternatives.limitation: Episodic percutaneous puncture — invasive per dose, infection risk 4-10%, requires clinical visit

current_alternatives.name: Intrathecal pump (SynchroMed)
current_alternatives.limitation: Bulky implant, $30K device, battery replacement every 5-7 years, surgical revision required

current_alternatives.name: Systemic delivery + BBB opening
current_alternatives.limitation: Off-target exposure, systemic toxicity, BBB-opening itself is investigational

value_chain.c3_advantage: Chronic controlled delivery INTEGRATED with eShunt anatomy — no separate pump pocket, no percutaneous puncture, no systemic exposure. For chronic therapies (gene therapy, monoclonal antibodies, chronic pain), C3's profile is distinct from all existing solutions.

economic_consequence.cost_avoidance_vs_pump: $30K device + $15K revision surgery avoided per patient per 5-7 years
economic_consequence.cost_avoidance_vs_ommaya: $500-1000 per puncture avoided, plus infection risk reduction

buyer_evidence_required.regulatory_pathway: 510(k) for device component; IND for drug-device combination

market_size_context.note: Market size is CONTEXT, not PROOF. Per CEO Round 138: 'Market-size numbers are extremely definition-sensitive. Use market data for decision-value prioritization, not as mechanism evidence.'
market_size_context.us_intrathecal_drugs_market: Approximately $1.07B (2025) to $1.38B (2032) per Fortune Business Insights — but this is the DRUG market, not the DEVICE market, and definition varies by source
market_size_context.intrathecal_pump_market: Separate estimate, varies by definition and geography
market_size_context.calibration_rule: Record: source, publication date, market definition, geography, base year, forecast year, estimate, confidence. Where sources disagree, record range.

C3_buyer_value_chain.gate_state_after: YELLOW (value chain mapped, buyer WTP unknown)
C3_buyer_value_chain.key_finding: C3's buyer value is NOT market size — it's the specific cost/risk avoidance vs existing CNS delivery methods. The value proposition is clear IF the retention mechanism works in vivo.
C3_buyer_value_chain.next_experiment: CereVasc buyer engagement for willingness-to-pay assessment. OR: animal model demonstration of retention mechanism (physical experiment, REALITY BLOCKER).

C1_reality_blocker.current_state: YELLOW — eShunt obstruction not yet observed in STRIDE 5-year data

what_exact_data_would_change_decision.data_required: eShunt-specific obstruction event rate from STRIDE 5-year follow-up
what_exact_data_would_change_decision.if_obstruction_rate_high: G01 → GREEN. C1 problem-existence confirmed. C1 advances toward WORLD_CLASS.
what_exact_data_would_change_decision.if_obstruction_rate_zero: G01 → RED. C1 KILLED_BY_EVIDENCE. No problem to solve.
what_exact_data_would_change_decision.if_obstruction_rate_low: G01 → YELLOW. C1 may not justify added device complexity.

C1_reality_blocker.stride_status: Enrollment complete across 32 sites. Topline data not yet publicly available per CereVasc public material.
C1_reality_blocker.ai_action: Do NOT repeatedly estimate obstruction frequency. Create this formal blocker object and continue working on other candidates/gates until STRIDE data is published.
C1_reality_blocker.epistemic_rule: Per Article XXXIV: reality is the next bottleneck for G01. Per Article XXXIII: no irreversible action on unresolved evidence. C1 remains BLOCKED, not KILLED, until STRIDE data resolves G01.

SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE.definition: Evidence about mechanism, physics, prior art, reproduction, model validation.

DECISION_VALUE_EVIDENCE.definition: Evidence about market size, buyer willingness-to-pay, cost savings, strategic fit.

scheduler_principle: Portfolio-level acquisition: EIG × P(decision_change) × independence × buyer_impact ÷ total_resource_cost. AI chooses globally highest-value action, not next-in-queue.
